versions.changelog:
Initial release of the RAGNARÖK Palette – a deep sea blue × sunset ochre universal color system for digital interfaces and visualizations.

- Provides a comprehensive dark UI color palette with unique, precise usage rules and fixed token values.
- Includes full design tokens (`tokens.css`), gradient backgrounds (`body-bg.css`), and a visual color showcase (`showcase.html`).
- Strict 8-rule system ensures consistency, accessibility, and signature "exploration by night" mood.
- Supports diverse visualizations and interface components (charts, dashboards, documents, etc.) with mapped usage guidelines.
- Reference files offer ready-to-use prompts and application details for designers and developers.
